title: 第1章 十七叔
content_zh:
第1章 十七叔
窗前有一盆绿萝，叶片肥大，精神饱满。
绿萝前有两张老旧办公桌拼在一起。中间堆着好多书，还有一台很有年代感的台式机，机身背后贴了一张海尔兄弟的贴纸。
桌子角落有把半秃的扫帚，还有个裂开一条缝的簸箕。
早晨，阳光明媚，照的绿萝越发的绿意盎然。
江远到了办公室，拉开椅子，坐下，开机，等待电脑
桌面的灰尘拍打了一下，收拾完，电脑也就开了。
他习惯性的咳嗽两声，
江远是宁台县新来的法医。
身材高大，长相干净。
稍微有点闲。
他想象中的法医是穿着白大褂，重案出击，哪里有案子，哪里就有他。
实际上……
江远来报道半个月了，小说看了十几本，又给三四个案子打了下手，尸体却是一具都没见着。
他着点来上班的，来了也不管他做什么。反正，没有尸体的时候，法医就只是一具基本劳动力罢了。
“砰！”门被撞开。
来人看到电脑前坐着的斯斯文文的江远，再努力的看了看：“老吴没来？”
“刘队。我师父应该还在路上。”江远抬了一下头，给回了一句。
刘队长是刑警大队二中队的队长，他扫视了一眼小小的办公室，掏出手机打电话的同时，道：“那你先跟我来，有尸体！”
江远惊喜又惊悚的站了起来。

开始了，他的职业生涯开启了。
果然，这时候，他眼前跳出来一个屏幕：
检测到宿主即将拥有第一具尸体，发布任务：做一次全面的尸检，协助侦破案件。
江远故作淡定，跟着刘队长出门。
是的，他有一个法医系统，自医科大学毕业，考公回到家乡宁台县，他就看到了这个系统。
然而，上班了半个月，系统完全没有动静，说要等尸体，着实令人焦躁。
要不是他江远是个守法公民，他都想自己现做一具了。
县一中。东门五十米巷子口。
先来的民警已经拉好了警戒带，还有一只帐篷搭在中间，遮盖住了外界的视线，很正规的样子。
“小江，你先做一点外围工作，你师父再一刻钟能到。”刘队长还不是太放心江远，先是叮嘱了一声。
江远应了，将随身携带的勘察箱和白布放在角落里，轻轻的喘了两口气。
再看向帐篷内。
里面躺着的，是一名身形肥胖，多肉厚肚的男子，脚上穿着一双红蜻蜓，格子衬衫的扣子被扯掉了几颗，肚皮白白的露在外头。
浑身上下看不到一个伤口，居然就死了，果然是神秘大案。
江远再往前走了一步，这才注意到死者脖子歪着，露出一个血肉模糊的洞，以及，非常熟悉的面容……
江远不由惊讶的喊出了声：“十七叔？”
新人新书，请大家推荐，
(本章完)
content_en:
Chapter 1 Uncle Seventeen
There is a pot of green radish in front of the window, with fat leaves and full of energy.
There are two old desks pushed together in front of the green radish. There are many books stacked in the middle, and there is also a very period desktop computer with a Haier Brothers sticker on the back.
There was a half-bald broom and a dustpan with a crack in the corner of the table.
In the morning, the sun shines brightly, and the green radish becomes more and more green.
Jiang Yuan arrived at the office, pulled out his chair, sat down, turned on the computer, and waited for it
I dusted the desktop and dusted it off, and then turned on the computer.
He coughed twice habitually,
Jiang Yuan is the new forensic doctor from Ningtai County.
Tall and clean looking.
A little bit free.
The forensic doctor in his imagination was wearing a white coat and working on serious cases. Wherever there was a case, he would be there.
Actually...
Jiang Yuan has been reporting for half a month. He has read more than a dozen novels and solved three or four cases, but not a single body has been found.
He came to work for the sake of it, and it didn't matter what he did when he came. Anyway, when there are no corpses, forensic doctors are just a basic labor force.
"Bang!" The door was knocked open.
The visitor saw the gentle Jiang Yuan sitting in front of the computer and looked hard: "Isn't Old Wu here?"
"Captain Liu. My master should still be on the way." Jiang Yuan raised his head and replied.
Captain Liu is the captain of the Second Squadron of the Criminal Police Brigade. He glanced at the small office, took out his mobile phone and made a call, and said: "Then follow me first, there is a body!"
Jiang Yuan stood up in surprise and horror.
It began, his career began.
Sure enough, at this time, a screen popped up in front of him:
It is detected that the host is about to have its first corpse, and a task is issued: to conduct a comprehensive autopsy and help solve the case.
Jiang Yuan pretended to be calm and followed Captain Liu out.
Yes, he has a forensic system. He has seen this system since he graduated from the Medical University and returned to his hometown of Ningtai County after taking the public examination.
However, after working for half a month, there was no movement from the system at all, and it was said that I had to wait for the body, which was really annoying.
If Jiang Yuan hadn't been a law-abiding citizen, he would have made one himself.
County No. 1 Middle School. Fifty meters from the east gate is the entrance to the alley.
The police who arrived first had already set up the warning tape, and a tent was set up in the middle, blocking the view of the outside world. It looked very formal.
"Xiao Jiang, you need to do some peripheral work first. Your master will be here in a quarter of an hour." Captain Liu was not too reassured about Jiang Yuan and warned him first.
Jiang Yuan agreed, put the survey box and white cloth he carried with him in the corner, and took a few breaths.
Look inside the tent again.
Lying inside was a fat man with a thick belly and a pair of red dragonflies on his feet. Several buttons of his plaid shirt had been torn off, and his belly was exposed in white.
There wasn't a single wound on his body, and yet he died. It was indeed a mysterious case.
Jiang Yuan took another step forward and noticed that the deceased's neck was tilted, revealing a bloody hole and a very familiar face...
Jiang Yuan couldn't help but shouted in surprise: "Uncle Seventeen?"
Newbies and new books, please recommend them.
(End of chapter)
